prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original front-facing 3D cinematic character concept portrait for AstralPact animal fable. Image 1 is ONLY reference for elegant anthropomorphic fox anatomy and high-end fur/material rendering, NOT its identity, outfit or jewelry. Image 2 is ONLY the feature-film CGI quality and dimensional lighting reference, do not copy dragon horns or royal ornaments.
New character: an adult female anthropomorphic RED FOX witch, original reinterpretation inspired by Melisandre the Red Priestess from Game of Thrones. Mature alluring, solemn, quietly intense and prophetic, sophisticated rather than cute. Slender elongated elegant proportions, copper russet fox fur, refined fox muzzle, tall fox ears fully visible, subtle cream on muzzle, amber eyes looking directly at camera. Long flowing deep copper-red hair parted centrally around fox ears, no crown. This is a separate character from the white fox celebrity reference.
Costume: deep oxblood and crimson medieval priestess gown, weighty silk and velvet, fitted graceful bodice, long sleeves and restrained antique gold flame embroidery, red mantle resting on shoulders. The KEY signature is a VERY LARGE oval faceted blood-red RUBY at the BASE OF HER NECK in an antique gold choker, approximately 5 cm tall, immediately eye-catching, complex deep internal red refraction, subtle emberlike core but physically dimensional gemstone, not a flat glowing red disc. Ruby clearly visible and unobstructed by hair. No diamonds, no pearl chains, no Chinese royal headdress.
Composition: single character facing perfectly forward, symmetrical shoulders, portrait vertical 2:3, head to upper thighs with both hands gracefully resting together near waist, anatomically coherent furry hands. Entire ear tips and hair in frame. Muted dark warm neutral backdrop with very faint defocused firelight, no objects competing with character. Calm composed expression with slight unsettling confidence.
High-end feature-film CGI, physically based materials, individually resolved fur and hair, fine velvet nap, silk weave, raised gold-thread embroidery, distinct aged gold and transparent ruby response. Soft warm key and subtle cool fill, crisp natural detail, rich restrained red palette, clear facial planes and readable dark cloth. Not live action actress likeness. No human face, no human ears, no dragon parts, no text, no watermark, no collage, no toy plastic, no overblown glow.
